description:
Joining upGrad has been one of the best decisions for my career. The program was well-planned, and the learning experience helped me strengthen both my technical knowledge and problem-solving skills. The practical approach to learning made me feel well-prepared for real interview scenarios.

I would also like to thank Sameer for his continuous support throughout the placement process. His timely guidance, interview tips, and regular follow-ups kept me motivated and confident at every stage.

I am delighted to have secured an opportunity with TCS, and I am grateful to the entire upGrad team for their constant support and dedication.

I had a wonderful learning experience with upGrad. The course content was well-structured, and the support provided throughout the journey was excellent.

I would also like to thank Sameer for his support during the interview process. His guidance, interview preparation tips, and encouragement helped me perform confidently and secure a good job opportunity.

I am grateful to the entire upGrad team for their support and would highly recommend upGrad to anyone looking to upskill and grow their career.

I've been enrolled in the Data Science program at upGrad's Learning Support Centre in Pune for a few months now, and overall it's been a worthwhile experience.

The curriculum structure is well thought out — it progressively moves from foundations (Python, statistics, SQL) into more advanced topics like machine learning and model deployment, which makes the learning curve manageable even for someone coming from a non-engineering background.

The mentors and doubt-solving sessions are genuinely helpful. Most faculty are approachable and explain concepts with real-world industry context rather than just theory.

Overall, if you're serious about building a career in data science and want structured guidance alongside the online content, the Pune Learning Support Centre is a solid choice.

My experience with upGrad has been excellent and truly helped me enhance my skills. The course content was well-structured, practical, and aligned with current industry requirements.

The hands-on projects and practical learning approach gave me the confidence to apply my knowledge in real-world scenarios. The placement support, interview guidance, and timely updates throughout the hiring process were also extremely helpful.

I am delighted to have secured an opportunity as a Prompt Engineer with Nvidia (Randstad Payroll). This achievement would not have been possible without the continuous support and guidance provided by the upGrad team.

I wanted to share my journey and express my gratitude for my time with upGrad! I had a great experience and thrived in the amazing learning environment here.

A huge thank you to Anil Kumar sir and Harsha sir for all their constant support. The GD sessions and hackathons were incredibly helpful, and the interview workshop was a game-changer. I also really appreciate the opportunity to serve as technical support for the AI training program for Group 1 officers of Telangana, which played a major role in helping me secure my job.

Thank you so much to our manager, Rajshekhar sir, and the entire upGrad team for all the support!
